document:96.text:
I don't feel dead at all.
I went back to visit my friends, and the people in town hurled stones at me. That's when it hit me.
Is this what it feels like to be an undead?
The cold doesn't bother me, so I can play in the snow for as long as I wish!
Also, I can keep going without feeling tired or hungry!
When I get bored, I can always frighten people! So cool!
document:96.source_cn:
我完全不觉得自己死了。
当我回到镇子找朋友玩时，镇上的人却拿石头丢我。直到那时候，我才知道自己变成了活死人。
这就是活死人吗？
我不会感觉到冷，想玩多久雪就可以玩多久的雪！
而且不管玩多久，我也不会感觉累和饿！
如果无聊，还可以去吓人！太酷啦！
document:96.document_title: Being an undead is the best!

document:97.text:
I met a nice lady! Her name's Carolina.
She said I wasn't an undead, I'm a Graveborn!
Graveborn only turn into undead if they lose their minds.
Carolina showed me the undead... They just wander around all lost, like they don't remember anything.
Will I end up like that too? No! I don't wanna!
Carolina said not all Graveborn turn into undead, but you've gotta be really strong to stop it.
I can totally do that! I mean, I can hold back my tears even when I miss Mommy so much!
That means I won't turn into an undead, right?
document:97.source_cn:
我认识了一位大姐姐！她的名字叫卡列琳娜。
姐姐告诉我，现在的我并不是活死人，而是亡灵。
当亡灵失去理智之后，才会成为活死人。
姐姐带我去看了真正的活死人，他们没有思维和记忆，只是在破房子周围游荡。
我也会变成那个样子吗？不要！我不要！
卡列琳娜姐姐说，并不是所有的亡灵最后都会变成活死人。但这需要很强的意志力……
意志力？我有啊！我都能控制自己想妈妈的时候不哭出来了！
那……我应该也不会变成活死人吧！
document:97.document_title: I don't want to lose my mind!

document:98.text:
Catalina, I'm leaving.
I've bin forgetting things these hays. No metal how herd I try, I can't seem too remember.
Catalina hasn't sad anything, but I no I'm about to loose control.
I don't one to bee a burden, so I'm leaving now.
Please don't leek for me.
document:98.source_cn:
大杰姐，我走了。
我最紧，很多事情，感觉自己开始记不其。不关我怎么努力，也想不起来。
虽然大杰姐一直没说，但窝、我知道，我快要失控了，对吗？
窝不要给大杰姐还有机器哥哥添麻烦，所以我先走了。
请不要找来招我。

document:99.text:
Watch out!
This is a warning from a spirit!
You are now my target!
I'll strike when you least expect it!
Boom!
document:99.source_cn:
看到这张纸条的人要小心了！
这是一份来自恐怖幽灵的吓人预告！
发现这张纸条的人，将成为我的吓人目标！
幽灵将会在你不注意的时候吓你！
吓！
